items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ray Copeland was working in that band. There was Art... Idees Sulieman played trumpet in that band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Out in Brooklyn. Actually, Ray Copeland was working in that band. There was Art... Idees Sulieman played trumpet in that band. Colbert Hopkins(?—23:26), Ray Abrams played saxophone... Sahib Shihab played baritone in that band, because Cecil Payne was the baritone player but he left and went on the road with Illinois Jacquet. And this guy, Howard Johnson, who played with Dizzy, played the lead, and the other boy, Ernie Henry, played the third alto. I saw the band. That was the Messengers. But the critics,…
